name: josefaidt-skills
description: Agent skills for writing, sourced answers, TypeScript monorepos, domain modeling, code and design review, session retrospectives, issue-driven coordination of agent sessions, and MCP Apps

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing standards for prose and internal documents, with PRD and business-doc structures, and language-agnostic guidance for code, such as when a comment earns its place

plugins.name: answering
plugins.description: Answers to factual and research questions grounded in cited sources, with a confidence level on each claim

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript conventions, styling UI with Tailwind CSS, Bun monorepo structure and setup, and scaffolding for new workspace packages

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: A project's domain model: the glossary its code and docs share, and ADRs for hard-to-reverse decisions

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: How a repository specifies features and gets them approved, the coding standards a reviewer enforces with stable rule IDs, and reviews of behavior, designs, and diffs that cite them

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Reflection that routes what a session taught to the file or check that should hold it, plain-language recaps of what an agent did and what waits on you, and the report that closes a milestone

plugins.name: learn-mcp-apps
plugins.description: MCP Apps in practice: the protocol and SDK, design patterns for Views, observed host behavior, and canonical references

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: GitHub repository setup with labels that route work to a model, issues sized for one session each, the procedure a session follows to carry one to a reviewed pull request, and a coordinator that runs a milestone's sessions
